measurement_notes: Input to present: XTEST send (CLOCK_MONOTONIC, stamped before sending) to the return of GPUI's Window::present for the next presented frame; held keys start at the app's receipt of each autorepeat.
Input to damage: the X server's XDamage notification for the app window after that present.
cpu_ms: main-thread CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID from Workspace::render start to the end of paint.
Percentiles pool every input of every run of a configuration, nearest rank.
Per-input input_to_present_ms and cpu_ms columns are kept for the quiet-host configurations; other metrics are pooled per configuration.
Private session paths are omitted; sources were verified unchanged in every run.
